entries.title: Playwright global setup: always seed grievance options
entries.summary: global-setup runs seed_grievance_options.php on default runs (idempotent) so grievance create/dashboard E2E has GRM/language/type/category inputs; E2E_SKIP_GRIEVANCE_OPTIONS_SEED=1 to opt out.
entries.tests: npm run test:e2e (grievance + dashboard suites); npm run test:e2e:smoke-full

entries.title: Grievance full self-contained: Library project + municipality/barangay
entries.summary: createProjectViaLibrary no longer uses removed area repeater; ensureMunicipalityAndBarangayForProject wires municipality_projects + barangays so the long self-contained spec passes on current Library UI.

entries.title: Shared grievance web helpers + full-application smoke E2E
entries.summary: tests/e2e/support/grievance-form-web.ts consolidates API unwrap, project pick, and required GRM-mode checks; dashboard + grievance specs refactored to import it; new serial smoke spec tests login → dashboard → create → list.

entries.title: E2E login settle: main.content + 45s default test timeout
entries.summary: submitLoginAndSettle waits for main.content (layout shell) instead of Profile nav-link only; playwright default test timeout 45s so login waits fit under global timeout.

entries.title: Dashboard grievance E2E: Select2 project + stable create
entries.summary: selectProjectOnGrievanceForm triggers jQuery change and asserts native value; dashboard-main create reorders fields, sets gender, scoped submit with waitForURL and longer test timeout.
